answer:
This looks like a paths issue.

spark-submit is a simple wrapper script, you can look at it with

cat $(which spark-submit)

This is how it looks like on my machine:

#!/usr/bin/env bash

#
# Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one or more
# ...

if [ -z "${SPARK_HOME}" ]; then
  source "$(dirname "$0")"/find-spark-home
fi

# disable randomized hash for string in Python 3.3+
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0

exec "${SPARK_HOME}"/bin/spark-class org.apache.spark.deploy.SparkSubmit "$@"

Make sure that you can run find-spark-home, that the variable $SPARK_HOME is set, and that the folder $SPARK_HOME contains a subfolder jars with the Spark jars.

Check that the version in the jar (for instance spark-core_2.12-3.1.2.jar) is compatible with the version of your Spark server (in this case Apache Spark 3.1.2).

Hope this helps!
